title: Verify the pointer prompt landed in the pane; resend bounded when it did not
action: Per D1: Herdr trait gains agent_text(job_id) -> Option<String> (real impl: herdr agent read <job_id> --source recent-unwrapped, transcript text; None on any trouble). New deliver_pointer helper: loop up to 5 attempts — agent_prompt(pointer), short injected-clock wait, agent_text contains the brief file name (e.g. brief-1.txt) => delivered; else resend. Exhaustion = typed failure keeping the pane. Wire into execute_new and execute_continue in place of the bare agent_prompt calls. Update FakeHerdr (agent_text serves a script: N empty reads then the pointer) and PanicHerdr. Tests: delivered on first try sends once; two empty reads then visible => exactly 3 sends... (assert resend count matches script); exhaustion keeps pane and names delivery in the message.

truths: A pointer invisible in the pane is resent, bounded at 5 attempts
Delivery exhaustion is a typed failure that keeps the pane
A visible pointer stops the resends
